description: Plan upravljanja pomorskim dobrom za 2019. godinu is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Rijeka. This Plan establishes the regular management of the maritime domain, the means for the regular management of the maritime domain, the list of activities referred to in the Single List of Activities in the Maritime domain (NN Nos 36/04, 63/08, 133/13 and 63/14), which may be carried out in the territory of the City of ... Coverage: Grad Rijeka. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime Goods Management Plan 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Rijeka. Its keywords include pomorsko dobro. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLS, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
